labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: www.imdb.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Ads)
[NSFW] [https://www.imdb.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.imdb.com%2F)

### Comment
> I've isolated a bug where domains confirmed as blocked by my active filter lists are still resolving live and serving content through my account's DNS servers. I've ruled out every variable on my end and would appreciate help checking server-side.
> 
> **Account/servers affected:**
> - DNS addresses: `94.140.14.49` / `94.140.14.59` (IPv4), `2a10:50c0::ded:ff` / `2a10:50c0::dad:ff` (IPv6)
> - Device profile: TP-Link Deco M5
> 
> **The issue:**
> `doubleclick.net` and `m.doubleclick.net` both show as **blocked** in your own "Check a domain" tool for this device:
> - `doubleclick.net` → blocked by **AdGuard DNS filter**, rule `||doubleclick.net^`
> - `m.doubleclick.net` → blocked by **OISD Blocklist Big**, rule `||m.doubleclick.net^`
> 
> But live queries to your resolvers return real answers for both, not a block:
> 
> ```
> nslookup doubleclick.net 94.140.14.49
> Server:  94-140-14-49.adguard-dns.com
> Address:  94.140.14.49
> 
> Non-authoritative answer:
> Name:    doubleclick.net
> Addresses:  2607:f8b0:4007:806::200e
>             142.251.41.14
> ```
> 
> **Live example — ad served from a blocked domain:**
> While browsing imdb.com, a banner ad loaded successfully via a request to `ad.doubleclick.net`, captured in my browser's Network tab:
> ```
> https://ad.doubleclick.net/ddm/adj/N805.2646AMAZONMEDIAGROUPLLC./B34608755.433941313;dc_ver=107.317;...
> ```
> Status: **200** (completed successfully)
> 
> This confirms the mismatch isn't limited to isolated `nslookup` testing — the domain is actively resolving and serving ad content in real browsing sessions despite being confirmed blocked.
> 
> **What I've ruled out:**
> - Local DNS cache — flushed repeatedly, no change
> - My own custom User Rules — tested with the toggle both on and off, no difference
> - My whitelist/custom filtering rules — checked for any rule referencing "doubleclick," none found
> - My router (TP-Link Deco M5, HomeShield security features disabled) and my ISP gateway (AT&T, IP Passthrough mode, Firewall Advanced settings all off) — ruled out by tethering a laptop to cellular data and querying `94.140.14.49` directly by IP, bypassing all home network equipment entirely. Same result: not blocked.
> - The Query Log shows no entry — blocked or otherwise — for queries to the bare `doubleclick.net` domain, even though live queries clearly reached your server and got an answer.
> 
> I would appreciate help figuring out why these ads are still not being blocked. 
> 
> Thanks,
> Josh

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://r.bouncycustom.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fr.bouncycustom.com%2F)

### Comment
> **Incorrect adult categorisation on the Family Protection server: bouncycustom.com / r.bouncycustom.com**
> 
> bouncycustom.com and its subdomain r.bouncycustom.com belong to Bouncy (https://bouncy.ai), a link-in-bio and link-management platform used by around 35,000 creators and small businesses. r.bouncycustom.com is a redirect endpoint only: it receives clicks from customers' own custom domains and forwards them to the customer's destination page. It hosts no content of its own (its root page shows only "Routing endpoint").
> 
> **What happens:** on the Family Protection server (family.adguard-dns.com), an A query for r.bouncycustom.com returns 94.140.14.35 instead of the real address 199.36.158.100 (Firebase Hosting). Safari then fails the TLS handshake with the sinkhole and shows "Safari can't open the page because it couldn't establish a secure connection to the server" (first screenshot). The same link works on cellular and on the Default server (second screenshot). bouncy.ai itself resolves normally on the Family server.
> 
> **Impact:** because every custom domain on the platform passes through this one redirect host, the block breaks all ~1,500 customer domains at once, including many non-adult businesses, for anyone on a network that uses the Family server.
> 
> **Why the categorisation is not appropriate:** the host does not serve sexual content. Where a customer's destination is age-restricted, the endpoint shows a plain age-confirmation page before redirecting, and the destination domain itself (for example onlyfans.com) is already categorised independently by the Family filter, so blocking the redirect host adds no protection. Comparable link services (linktr.ee, bit.ly, beacons.ai) resolve normally on the Family server.
> 
> **Request:** please recategorise bouncycustom.com and r.bouncycustom.com as a redirect / link-management service and remove them from the adult category on the Family Protection server.
> 
> Steps to reproduce: set DNS to family.adguard-dns.com, then open https://r.bouncycustom.com/ in any browser.

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://reports.adguard.info/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Freports.adguard.info%2F) ### Comment > Ребят, я прошу прощения, но новая 8 версия работает плохо. > Сил уже нет... > Детализирую конструктивно. > На 7й было все просто отлично (на ней можно сидеть как можно дольше?). > Что сейчас: просто по истечении времени DNS отваливается у приложения. Появляется ошибка как в браузере (DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NO_INTERNET), так и в таких абсолютно не связанных приложениях, как, например, Nicotine+. Просто нет коннекта. И это НЕ РКН! > Отключаю полностью AdGuard - все начинает работать. > Причем: работает блокировщик + VPN в связке. Проблема выше не уходит при отключении AdGuard - Надо еще и AdGuard VPN отключать. Идиотизм какой-то... > Пробовал отключать DNS-защиту из приложения - 0 результата. Менять на DoH, обычный и т.п. - без результата. DNS Google или иные - нет результата. > Причем, смотрите, тот же Nicotine и подобные (не браузеры) внесены в нефильтруемые - все равно такое. Не понимаю, как исключить тогда из фильтрации AdGuard? > Смена SockFilter и/или WFP не решает проблему. на WFP еще и bsod'ы участились с ошибкой NETIO.SYS (DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL). > > Итог: > 1. Что не так, что нужно исправить? > 2. Что необходимо сделать, чтобы, например, вся защита и фильтрация были исключительно применимы к браузерам, а не локальному ПО. Текущее исключение не работает. ### Screenshots

### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://intercelestial.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fintercelestial.com%2F) ### Comment > Anti-adblock wall on intercelestial.com cannot be bypassed or blocked > > The site uses "AntiAdBlock Core" to display a fixed-position popup dialog demanding the user disable their adblocker. The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. These requests are triggered by pages hosted on domains listed in the domain= option of $popup rules from the Liste FR and Liste AR filter lists. > > Standard ad-blocking behavior dictates that the $popup modifier should only block document navigations that open new tabs or windows. It should not apply to XHR or media requests loading content within the current page or iframe. > As mentioned by the Liste AR/Liste FR maintainer [here](https://github.com/easylist/listear/issues/46#issuecomment-5540724117) > > ##Affected Rules > 1. Liste FR > Rule: > > $popup,domain=111movies.com|...|luluvdo.com|...|streamtape.com|... > > > 2. Liste AR > (Previously reported) > Rule: > > $popup,third-party,domain=4yftwvrdz7.sbs|6sfkrspw4u.sbs|ak.sv|alkoora.live|animeiat.tv|arabveturk.com|hd7live.xyz|hyperwatching.com|iplayerhls.com|koora-stream.live|koora24.sbs|kora-api.top|kora-tv.vip|larhu.website|segavid.com|strema.top|topcinema.cam|turkvearab.com|yalla4shoot.live > > > ##Specific Case: Liste FR > Trigger Page: 'https://luluvdo.com' (Explicitly listed in the domain= option of the Liste FR rule). > Blocked Request: The page attempts to load an HLS playlist: > 'https://cdn1020.cdn-tnmr.org/hls2/01/04333/wnis4myylpit_h/master.m3u8?t=c8CR0UQKCux6w592zgPk0jJxPD2bVIhlO5goClqYIk0&s=1789882305&e=28800&f=21665630&i=0.3&sp=0' > > Result: AdGuard blocks this request as a "popup," causing the video player to fail. > Mechanism: The rule is active because the page originates from luluvdo.com. However, the blocked request is an internal XHR/media fetch, not a new window navigation. > > ##Steps to Reproduce > 1. Enable EasyList, Liste FR, and Liste AR in AdGuard. > 2. Navigate to 'https://www.stardima.com/tvshow/video-58/play/1445'. > 3. Attempt to play an embedded video. > 4. Click on Lulustream (video server) > 5. Result: The video player fails to load. > > ##Workaround > Disabling Liste FR or Liste AR or whitelisting the specific domain allows the video to load. > > ##Observations > Comparison with Adblock Plus: Using the exact same filter lists in Adblock Plus does not block these requests. issue.title: raw.githubusercontent.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Ads) [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/refs/heads/master/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FAdguardTeam%2FAdguardFilters%2Frefs%2Fheads%2Fmaster%2FBaseFilter%2Fsections%2Fforeign.txt) ### Comment > I propose creating the AdGuard Polish Filter. > > # Why is the AdGuard Polish Filter necessary? > > ## Internet Usage > > According to the W3C, the amount of content on the Internet by language is as follows: > https://w3techs.com/technologies/overview/content_language > Let’s focus on the languages for which AdGuard does not have its own filters: > > - Italian: 2.8% > - Polish: 1.8% > - Czech & Slovak (combined): 1.3% > > Polish is a widely used language on the internet, more so than Turkish or Chinese. > > ## Number of Rules in AdGuard > > Furthermore, ad blocking is very popular in Poland, and AdGuard has received a large number of issues related to it. > > As a result, in the foreign languages section of the AdGuard Base Filter, Polish rules are disproportionately numerous, accounting for about one-third of the total. > https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt > > Currently, the number of Polish rules in the foreign languages section of the Base Filter has already surpassed the number of rules in the AdGuard Dutch Filter. > > ## Benefits of Creating an AdGuard Polish Filter > > There are many benefits. > > - Polish speakers will find it easier to use the extensive set of Polish rules in the AdGuard Base Filter for various purposes. For example, when using uBlock Origin, they will be able to select AdGuard’s Polish rules without having to use the AdGuard Base Filter. > - There are benefits for non-Polish speakers as well. Currently, the large number of Polish rules included in the base filter are unnecessary for non-Polish speakers, yet nearly all users are forced to have them as part of the base filter. ### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://intercelestial.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fintercelestial.com%2F) ### Comment > Anti-adblock wall on intercelestial.com cannot be bypassed or blocked > > The site uses "AntiAdBlock Core" to display a fixed-position popup dialog demanding the user disable their adblocker. The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. The site is fully JS-dependent so this is not a workaround. > Manual inspection found the injected HTML (included below) but the randomized attributes prevent writing a persistent blocking rule. > > Injected overlay HTML (captured from one session in Brave): > > <div data-c30b98078-card="" style="position:fixed;top:12vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)..." role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> > <!-- "Adblocker detected" dialog with buttons "I've disabled it" / "Reload page" --> > <!-- Footer: intercelestial.com · powered by AntiAdBlock Core --> > </div> > ### Screenshots

This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 3 days with no activity.
Unfortunately, our resources are limited and we can not always take the time to respond to requests about websites that are not popular enough. The issue will be closed if no further activity occurs.

issue.body:
### Prerequisites
- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use NSFW-specific form;
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?
AdGuard Browser Extension, Other ad blocker

### AdGuard version
latest / all

### What type of problem have you encountered?
Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?
Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge

### Which device do you use?
Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?
https://www.bergfreunde.de/lowa-nuvolo-freizeitschuhe/

### What filters do you have enabled?
AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, EasyPrivacy

### Add your comment and screenshots
The sizing assistant ("Größenberater" / Fit Finder provided by FitAnalytics) on product detail pages (e.g. `https://www.bergfreunde.de/lowa-nuvolo-freizeitschuhe/`) is blocked and does not load when AdGuard Tracking Protection / Spyware filter is enabled.

Due to the general rule `||fitanalytics.com^$third-party` in SpywareFilter/tracking_servers.txt, `https://integrations.fitanalytics.com/shop/bergfreunde/pdp.js` and `https://widget.fitanalytics.com/` are completely blocked, breaking the sizing advisor functionality on the shop.

Similar to the existing allowlist rules for Modivo and Pull&Bear in `SpywareFilter/sections/allowlist.txt`, could you please add an allowlist exception for all Bergfreunde international online shops?

The group operates under multiple country domains and brands:
- `bergfreunde.de`, `bergfreunde.at` / `berg-freunde.at`, `berg-freunde.ch`, `bergfreunde.nl`, `bergfreunde.be`, `bergfreunde.it`, `bergfreunde.es`, `bergfreunde.eu`, `bergfreunde.dk`, `bergfreunde.se`, `bergfreunde.no`, `bergfreunde.fi`
- `alpinetrek.co.uk`
- `alpiniste.fr`
- `campz.ie`

Suggested rules (using wildcards or explicit domains):
```
@@||integrations.fitanalytics.com/shop/bergfreunde/pdp.js$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.*
@@||widget.fitanalytics.com/widget_zepto.js$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.*
@@||widget.fitanalytics.com/widget_pdp.js$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.*
@@||widget.fitanalytics.com/widget/api/$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.*
```

### Privacy
- [x] I agree to follow this condition

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use NSFW-specific form; - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension, Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version latest / all ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://www.bergfreunde.de/lowa-nuvolo-freizeitschuhe/ ### What filters do you have enabled? AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, EasyPrivacy ### Add your comment and screenshots The sizing assistant ("Größenberater" / Fit Finder provided by FitAnalytics) on product detail pages (e.g. `https://www.bergfreunde.de/lowa-nuvolo-freizeitschuhe/`) is blocked and does not load when AdGuard Tracking Protection / Spyware filter is enabled.
Screenshots:



Due to the general rule `||fitanalytics.com^$third-party` in SpywareFilter/tracking_servers.txt, `https://integrations.fitanalytics.com/shop/bergfreunde/pdp.js` and `https://widget.fitanalytics.com/` are completely blocked, breaking the sizing advisor functionality on the shop. Similar to the existing allowlist rules for Modivo and Pull&Bear in `SpywareFilter/sections/allowlist.txt`, could you please add an allowlist exception for all Bergfreunde international online shops? The group operates under multiple country domains and brands: - `bergfreunde.de`, `bergfreunde.at` / `berg-freunde.at`, `berg-freunde.ch`, `bergfreunde.nl`, `bergfreunde.be`, `bergfreunde.it`, `bergfreunde.es`, `bergfreunde.eu`, `bergfreunde.dk`, `bergfreunde.se`, `bergfreunde.no`, `bergfreunde.fi` - `alpinetrek.co.uk` - `alpiniste.fr` - `campz.ie` Suggested rules (using wildcards or explicit domains): ``` @@||integrations.fitanalytics.com/shop/bergfreunde/pdp.js$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.* @@||widget.fitanalytics.com/widget_zepto.js$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.* @@||widget.fitanalytics.com/widget_pdp.js$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.* @@||widget.fitanalytics.com/widget/api/$domain=bergfreunde.*|berg-freunde.*|alpinetrek.*|alpiniste.*|campz.* ``` ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973
